description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. SEC Form 4 insider transaction intelligence. Mode get_insider_trades: Form 4 filings for a ticker in the last N days — insider name, role, buy/sell type, shares, price, total value, and net buy/sell sentiment.
